# PP: same-path copy of vanilla's disaster, written by `uv run ppc disasters apply` (src/prosper_or_perish_constructor/disaster_breaking_point.py); do not edit.
curse_of_stefan_uros_iii = {

	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/curse_of_stefan_uros_iii.dds"
	
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_very_high

	fire_only_once = yes

	can_start = {
		pp_disaster_restart_allowed_trigger = { type = curse_of_stefan_uros_iii } # PP: breaking point

		has_any_active_disaster = no
		tag = SER
		current_year < 1453
		country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
		character:ser_stefan_dusan = {
			is_alive = no
		}
		ruler ?= { total_abilities <= 250 }
		stability <= 30
		government_power <= 75
	}
	

	can_end = { # PP: breaking point: vanilla's way out, or the breaking point
		OR = {
			AND = {
		curse_of_stefan_uros_iii_end_trigger = yes
	}
			pp_disaster_breaking_point_trigger = { type = curse_of_stefan_uros_iii }
		}
	}
	modifier = {
		monthly_pretender_rebel_growth  = 0.025
		monthly_nationalist_rebel_growth   = 0.025
		monthly_legitimacy = -0.25
	}
	
	on_start = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = curse_of_stefan_uros_iii.1
	}
	on_end = { # PP: breaking point: past it without vanilla's way out, vanilla's end without the reward, then the blow
		if = {
			limit = {
				pp_disaster_breaking_point_trigger = { type = curse_of_stefan_uros_iii }
				NOT = { AND = {
		curse_of_stefan_uros_iii_end_trigger = yes
	} }
			}
			
			set_variable = had_serbian_disaster_variable
			pp_disaster_breaking_point_effect = { type = curse_of_stefan_uros_iii }
		}
		else = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = curse_of_stefan_uros_iii.2
	}
		pp_disaster_escalation_cleanup_effect = { type = curse_of_stefan_uros_iii }
	}
	
	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			20 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			80 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			random_list = {
				1000 = {}
				50 = { trigger_event_silently = curse_of_stefan_uros_iii.3 }
				50 = { trigger_event_silently = curse_of_stefan_uros_iii.4 }
				50 = { trigger_event_silently = curse_of_stefan_uros_iii.5 }
				100 = { trigger_event_silently = curse_of_stefan_uros_iii.6 }
			}
		}
		# PP: breaking point
		pp_disaster_escalation_effect = { type = curse_of_stefan_uros_iii }
	}
}
